evals.prompt: add rate limiting and quotas at our api gateway
evals.expected_output: Separates rate limits (short-window, tied to a measured backend capacity number, protects the backend) from quotas (long-window, business entitlement per client), and ensures a 429 response tells the caller which control they hit and when to retry.

evals.prompt: gateway keeps timing out and now it's taking every backend down with it
evals.expected_output: Identifies the gateway as a single point of failure on the critical path for all backend traffic, recommends capacity-testing the gateway itself and deploying it with the same rigor (canary, rollback, redundancy across zones) as any production service.

evals.prompt: can we just reshape this one team's payload format inside the gateway config
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: business-specific transformation for a single backend doesn't belong in the gateway since it turns the gateway into an undeployable dependency every team is afraid to touch; recommends handling it in that service even at the cost of one more hop.
